jobs.title: Director of Major Gifts
jobs.description:
Company Description
McCallum Theatre is a performing arts organization based at 73-000 Fred Waring Drive in Palm Desert, California, serving the greater Palm Springs area. The theatre presents a wide range of live performances and cultural events, attracting audiences from across the region and beyond. As a community-focused institution, McCallum Theatre values artistic excellence, education, and outreach. Team members contribute to a dynamic environment that supports both world-class performances and local engagement. The organization offers opportunities for professionals who are passionate about the arts and philanthropy.
Role Description
The Director of Major Gifts is a full-time, on-site role based in Palm Springs, CA, responsible for developing and managing relationships with donors to secure significant philanthropic support for McCallum Theatre. This role oversees a portfolio of major gift prospects, designs individualized cultivation and solicitation strategies, and conducts regular in-person meetings, calls, and follow-ups with donors and prospects. The Director collaborates with executive leadership and development staff to align fundraising priorities with the theatre’s strategic goals, prepares proposals and presentations, and coordinates donor recognition and stewardship activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include prospect research, tracking activity in the donor database, planning donor events, and working closely with colleagues to integrate major giving with annual campaigns and planned giving initiatives.
Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in major gifts, annual giving, and stewardship, with the ability to build and maintain long-term donor relationships.
Knowledge of planned giving strategies and vehicles, and experience integrating planned gifts into overall fundraising efforts.
Experience in prospect research and alumni or constituent relations, including identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing potential donors.
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage donors, board members, and community stakeholders.
Proven ability to meet fundraising goals, manage a donor portfolio, and work collaboratively in a team-oriented, mission-driven environment.
Comfort working on-site with frequent in-person meetings and events in the Palm Springs area, including some evenings and weekends.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as nonprofit management, communications, arts administration, or equivalent experience.
Background in performing arts, cultural institutions, or nonprofits is highly beneficial.

jobs.title: Director of Operations QSR NYC
jobs.description:
Apply here or get in touch with us directly:
hiring@personenyc.com

We are looking for a
DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS

High-Growth Healthy QSR / Fast-Casual Restaurant Group | New York City
$160,000–$180,000 Base + Performance Bonus

Target Total Compensation: $180,000–$200,000

Major NYC Expansion Underway | Clear Path to VP of Operations

An incredibly exciting opportunity for an experienced NYC restaurant operator to join a highly successful, growing healthy QSR / fast-casual restaurant group
at a pivotal moment in its expansion.

This is not an early-stage concept still trying to figure things out. The business is successful, well positioned for growth and has already built a strong corporate foundation around its restaurants. Key leadership functions are in place, the company operates with a modern, technology-driven approach, and there is a significant pipeline for additional locations.
Now they are looking for an exceptional Director of Operations
who can take ownership of restaurant operations, develop the next generation of leaders and help build the infrastructure necessary to scale.
The role reports directly to the CEO and sits alongside the company's existing HQ leadership team. As the right person grows into the position, the goal is for the DOO to take increasing ownership of operations, allowing the CEO to focus more heavily on strategy and future growth.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for much more than someone who can manage multiple restaurants.
The ideal candidate is a builder
— someone who has experienced restaurant growth firsthand, understands what it takes to open successful new locations and knows how to create systems that make a growing organization stronger rather than more complicated.
You'll oversee and develop General Managers, Kitchen Managers and other restaurant leaders while creating the structure needed for future Area / Regional leadership.
You'll help strengthen SOPs, training programs, reporting, communication and accountability across the organization. You'll be deeply involved in new openings and help make sure the company has the right people, systems and standards in place before each new restaurant opens its doors.
The company is specifically looking for someone who can turn its successful operating model into a repeatable playbook for growth
, without sacrificing food quality, culture or performance along the way.

THE PERFECT BACKGROUND: QSR + FULL-SERVICE NYC HOSPITALITY

This is probably the most important part of the profile.
We would love to find someone who has worked successfully in both QSR / fast-casual and full-service restaurants, ideally in New York City.

From the QSR world, you understand systems, efficiency, technology, labor, KPIs, high-volume execution, standardization and scalability.

But your full-service background means you also understand something equally important:
Hospitality is about people.

You love restaurants. You enjoy being around teams. You know how to motivate a GM, recognize emerging talent and build a culture where people want to perform and grow.
You can analyze a P&L and build an SOP, but you're equally comfortable walking into a busy restaurant, connecting with the team and understanding within 20 minutes what's really happening in the operation.
We don't want someone who manages restaurants exclusively through spreadsheets and dashboards.
We want a restaurant person who also happens to be an exceptional business operator.

BUILD TEAMS. OPEN RESTAURANTS. SCALE THE BUSINESS.

A major part of this opportunity will be supporting the company's continued NYC expansion.
We're especially interested in candidates who have opened multiple restaurants and helped scale a growing restaurant group
— someone who understands that opening locations isn't simply about construction schedules and opening checklists.
It's about people.
Who will run the next restaurant? Who on today's team can become tomorrow's GM? Which GM has the potential to become an Area Leader? How early do we hire and train new managers? How do we make sure every new location delivers the same standards without losing its hospitality?
You'll help answer those questions while building the leadership pipeline behind the company's growth.
The current expansion plan calls for additional NYC locations through 2027, making this an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the company's next generation of restaurants.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Multi-unit restaurant operations and performance
Development and coaching of GMs and restaurant leadership
New restaurant openings and operational readiness
P&L, labor, food cost, budgeting and forecasting
SOPs and scalable operational systems
Manager training and leadership development
Restaurant KPIs, reporting and performance analysis
Operational audits and continuous improvement
Succession planning and internal talent development
Cross-functional collaboration with CEO and HQ leadership
Building the infrastructure needed for continued expansion

One of the best ways to describe the company's philosophy for this role is simple: your success should be measured by what happens when you're not in the building.

The goal is to develop managers into confident, accountable leaders who can independently run excellent restaurants.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of progressive multi-unit restaurant operations experience
, with a strong preference for someone who understands the NYC market.
You should have a track record of scaling restaurant operations, opening new locations, developing strong GMs and building systems that actually work in restaurants.

We're particularly interested in someone with:
Experience across both QSR / fast casual and full-service restaurants

Strong multi-unit NYC restaurant experience
Multiple successful new restaurant openings
Excellent P&L and financial acumen
Experience building SOPs, training programs and scalable systems
Strong understanding of restaurant technology and performance metrics
A track record of developing and promoting leaders
Excellent communication and organizational skills
Genuine passion for hospitality and people
The ability to balance high standards with a positive, collaborative leadership style

Experience with franchising or preparing a restaurant company for larger-scale expansion would be a strong plus.

COMPENSATION & GROWTH
Base Salary: $160,000–$180,000

Target Total Compensation: $180,000–$200,000
, including a performance-based bonus program tied to clear, measurable goals.
Additional benefits include a $1,000 monthly healthcare stipend, Paid Time Off, complimentary meals and leadership development opportunities.

Most importantly, this role has a clear pathway toward Vice President of Operations
as the company continues to expand.

WHY THIS ROLE?
Because this is the sweet spot for an ambitious operator.
The company is already successful and has the leadership, resources and momentum to grow — but it's still at a stage where the person joining today can have a real influence on what the organization looks like tomorrow.
The systems you build can become the company's future playbook. The managers you develop can become its next generation of leaders. And the restaurants you help open can become the foundation for much bigger growth.
If you bring the discipline of QSR, the hospitality instincts of full-service restaurants, and a genuine love for building teams and opening restaurants
, this could be an exceptional next chapter in your career.

hiring@personenyc.com

jobs.title: Head of Middle Office Services - Fund Services, Investor Services Managing Director
jobs.description:
Head of Middle Office Services - Fund Services, Investor Services Managing Director – C16

Location New York City / Boston / London

Reporting line Head of Fund Services, Investor Services

About Citi

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients. Citi’s Mission and Value Proposition explains what we do and Citi Leadership Standards explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain both our clients’ and the public’s trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviours that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful, strengthening our ability to execute against our strategic priorities. Diversity is a key business imperative and a source of strength at Citi. We serve clients from every walk of life, every background and every origin. Our goal is to have our workforce reflect this same diversity at all levels. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work, where individuals are promoted based on merit, where we value and demand respect for others and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all. We foster a culture of meritocracy and diversity; we value and expect respect for others; opportunities to develop are widely available to all. 51% of our employees are women and 24% of our Director’s and Managing Directors are women.

About Citi Investor Services As part of Citi’s Services business, Investor Services is a global business that provides Custody, Fund Services, Issuer Services and Securities Finance to global asset managers, pension funds, insurance companies, banks and financial intermediaries. Investor Services operates the largest custody network globally with a presence in 60+ countries.

Position Summary

Do you excel at seeing and driving to the future state the Fund Services Industry despite knowing in detail the complexity of the current state in the highly data driven and complex area of Middle Office outsourcing? Are you a commercial, tech and operational change savvy business leader who doesn’t settle for good enough and pushes all to be the best? The role is to lead our Fund Services Middle Office function globally. This is global a P&l ownership role and therefore requires a deep hands-on working knowledge of the Funds business and in particular proven delivery of complex lift outs and builds for a global middle office service for asset managers. . The candidate would be required to lead, change, improve and grow materially the middle office function using technology as the enabler working hand in hand with operations, technology, our client teams and indeed our clients across a very broad US, Lux, Irish, Australian plus many smaller markets where we provide Middle Office services across existing and target clients.

The Product Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. Timely execution, seamless business and client change are extremely important to ensure Fund Services continues its growth path and expands its relationships with strategic clients.

Reporting to the Global Head of Fund Services, the Global Head of Middle Office services will lead strategic transformational change at the core of our business driving growth though innovation, digitisation, operating and financial performance. As part of the leadership team, this role will leverage broad Middle Office domain knowledge, deep experience influencing product, operations, design, and IT architecture change, as they lead the global function ensuring a 24/6 model delivering a single client experience across the globe.

Responsibilities

Commercially and strategically minded with responsibility to develop and execute the Middle Office strategy that aligns to the wider InvestorServices Strategy.
Ownership of the Global P&L for the function driving QoQ improvements via Monthly Business Review (MBR) deliverables
Own the IBOR product globally and partner with the accounting (ABOR) and Transfer Agency teams
Own pricing decisions for current and new Middle Office business and represent the funds business at local / regional and global deal review meetings
Expertise in all asset classes as they relate to a Middle Office service.
Be the difference between the think and the execution.
Work closely with Product owners to develop and drive product roadmaps that are inclusive of business operations and technology future change needs that have a keen eye on client experience, financial performance, control, and scalability.
Change the operating model of existing clients to drive efficiency, scale, lower risk and performance.
Collaborate with Business, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Finance and Risk to deliver upon future state front to back business architectures for ultimately single IBOR / ABOR capabilities enabling optimized solutions with low process friction between groups and functions.
Develop and communicate the product strategy & governance principles aimed at optimizing straight through processing and guaranteeing the timeliness, completeness, accuracy, and internal consistency of the accounting product and the resultant financial reporting, business processing, and overall client experience success.
Manage a broad range of data and SaaS vendors that provide services / data to the business. Ensure the bank wide standards are met for all vendors including strict commercial discipline. These will include global providers like Charles River, Blackrock Aladdin, Bloomberg AIM, Simcorp etc.
Design, build and deploy an enterprise data model that supports the end to end Middle Office business and aligns to the broader business data strategy.
Champion continuous improvement through a Product Innovation & Governance committee - driving adoption of industry best practices, and training to ensure that the Services business is a leader in the industry for modern and digital processes.
Leverage a strong understanding of the business strategy, key stakeholders and business capability and create solution roadmaps for clients and our teams
Solicit business and technical specific requirements with the understanding of how those fit into the broader enterprise context bringing them to the transformation / technology teams for enablement and delivery.
Socialize future state vision with all other Citi partners.
Own the Middle Office portfolio of work including with our technology vendors.
Spearhead and lead Agile initiatives and dynamically create agile squads. Head of Middle Office Services – Fund Services
Face off with both Fund Services and the broader Investor Services Transformation team to ensure connectivity, driving and owning the budgets for change.
Champion of communication across the global function ensuring no duplication or overlap looking for synergies with every decision.
Key partner for our client team and a trusted leader to deliver for the clients
Help drive Data team culture.
Work with Risk & Control team to implement data access controls.
Work with Legal, Risk, & Compliance partners on program policies
Lead efforts to establish, formalize and communicate business solutions and educate business stakeholders particularly the client teams on value and importance of proposed accounting solutions.
Work closely with all technical partners to align strategic technical investments to the target state business architecture or justify any deviations.
Drive client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, multiple countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within a region or business
Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
Drive a positive Voice of the Employee (VOE) rating each year – lead by example

Qualifications

10-15+ years Middle Office industry experience ideally in a fund services business or as a COO of a recognised asset manager. Ideally have a proven track record in re-engineering efforts across multiple Middle Office platforms (CRD, Aladdin , BBG AIM, SCD)
Exceptional communication & presentation skills
Have previous experience working with C-Suite stakeholders.
Has superior strategic, analytic and problem-solving skills, and is capable of clearly communicating a long term vision across the company and clients
Natural collaborator. Partner with product management teams and product delivery executives to ensure both product and client roadmaps and implementation strategies are aligned to technology and business investments.
Extensive experience in business process technology architecture engineering /implementations
Deep industry experience in tech solutions for Middle Office Services (Traditional and Alts)
Outcome oriented, with a successful track record of delivering excellence for our clients
Self-motivated, independent, multi-tasker, willing and able to take ownership of various parts of an initiative.
Ability to effectively deliver under time pressure, clarifying ambiguity as needed to deliver against expectations.
Ability to coordinate and tie break in complex and siloed organizations through Influence and develop strong relationships by driving value added change.
Must be disciplined and comfortable with ambiguity, possessing the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and a global matrixed organization
Ability to elevate the conversation to client’s needs and objectives, and also dig into the details and process flows
Flexible – demonstrated experience working effectively with multiple stake holders Head of Middle Office Services – Fund Services
Strong analytical skills, including numbers and situational analyses, and high attention to detail
Organization and project management skills, including effective cross-functional management skills
Team player
Able to prioritize work, and shift priorities as needed to meet aggressive deadlines and milestones
Promotes teamwork and builds strong relationships within and across global teams
B

jobs.description:
Overview

$10,000 Sign On Bonus

Looking for a career that makes a difference every day?

Discover a rewarding career at Enhabit Home Health & Hospice, one of the nation’s largest home-based care providers. Consistently recognized as a great place to work, Enhabit delivers exceptional care and fosters a collaborative culture that supports professional growth and ongoing development.

With strong organizational stability, a commitment to excellence, and careers rooted in purpose, Enhabit empowers team members to build forward-moving careers while expanding what’s possible for care in the home.

The Enhabit Advantage:

Enhabit offers competitive benefits designed to support well-being and help employees thrive in every stage of their careers. Eligible employees receive:

$10,000 Sign On Bonus
Generous paid time off for full-time employees
401(k) matching
Medical, dental and vision coverage
Supplemental insurance options
Flexible spending accounts
Incentive bonus opportunities
Continuing education and scholarship opportunities

Responsibilities

Serve as the local chief executive agent. Lead the local provider(s) in a better way to care for the community in which it serves, and contribute to the overall success of the company. Ensure the execution of operations are completed daily. Manage operations, services, personnel performance, and office management ongoing.

Qualifications

Must have an associate degree in a health related field and two years' as a manager or supervisor.
Must not have been employed in the last year as an administrator with another operation at the time any enforcement action was taken against the business; further described in the company compliance policies.
Must have intermediate demonstrated technology skills, including operation of a mobile device.

Education And Experience, Preferred

A licensed physician, registered nurse, licensed social worker, licensed therapist, or a licensed nursing home administrator is preferred.
Previous experience in a home health care or hospice program is preferred.

Education and experience, state specific

A master degree in nursing with an active license to practice nursing in the state and at least one year of

supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility program which included care of the sick; or a

master degree in public health or administration with a concentration of study in health services administration, and at least one year of supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a baccalaureate degree in nursing with an active license to practice nursing in the state and at least two years supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a baccalaureate degree in administration with a concentration of study in health services administration and at least two years supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a physician licensed to practice medicine and surgery in the state of Connecticut who has had at least one year supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or employment as the administrator of a home health care agency in this state as of January 1, 1981, who has been so employed continuously for the five years immediately preceding January 1, 1981; or continuous employment as an administrator of a home health care agency as of January 1, 1979 ; except that on and after January 1, 1986, no person shall be employed as an administrator of a home health care agency pursuant to this subdivision unless such person additionally meets one of the requirements above. Must be administrator for only one agency.

Must be a licensed physician, licensed registered nurse, a social worker with a master's degree, or a college

graduate with a bachelor's degree, and have three years management experience in health care service

delivery. Any person who was employed by a licensed Louisiana hospice as the administrator as of December 20, 1998 is exempt from these requirements as long as he/she remains employed by that hospice as the administrator. If the hospice is acquired, sold to or merged into another legal entity, this exemption still stands.

MARYLAND

Must possess education in health services or administration, evidenced by being a physician; registered nurse; or college graduate with a bachelor degree in a health-related field. Must also have at least one year of supervisory experience in hospital, home health, or public health program management.

MASSACHUSETTS

Must have two years of relevant experience in the health care, human services, or related fields, which shall

include at least one year of supervisory or administrative experience.

OKLAHOMA

Must possess an Oklahoma administrator license. Must complete eight continuing education units per year.

SOUTH CAROLINA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

TEXAS

Must comply with Texas state regulation 97.259 a-g requiring 24 hours of training in the first 12 months if a first time administrator. Must have documented completion of a minimum of 12 clock hours per year at a health administration seminar or through an approved provider.

Requirements

Must possess a valid state driver license
Must maintain automobile liability insurance as required by law
Must maintain dependable transportation in good working condition
Must be able to safely drive an automobile in all types of weather conditions

Additional Information

Enhabit Home Health & Hospice is an equal opportunity employer. We work to promote differences in a collaborative and respectful manner. We are committed to a work environment that supports, encourages and motivates all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, genetic information, or other protected characteristic. At Enhabit, we celebrate and embrace the special differences that makes our community extraordinary.

new_jobs.title: Head of Middle Office Services - Fund Services, Investor Services Managing Director
new_jobs.description:
Head of Middle Office Services - Fund Services, Investor Services Managing Director – C16

Location New York City / Boston / London

Reporting line Head of Fund Services, Investor Services

About Citi

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients. Citi’s Mission and Value Proposition explains what we do and Citi Leadership Standards explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain both our clients’ and the public’s trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviours that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful, strengthening our ability to execute against our strategic priorities. Diversity is a key business imperative and a source of strength at Citi. We serve clients from every walk of life, every background and every origin. Our goal is to have our workforce reflect this same diversity at all levels. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work, where individuals are promoted based on merit, where we value and demand respect for others and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all. We foster a culture of meritocracy and diversity; we value and expect respect for others; opportunities to develop are widely available to all. 51% of our employees are women and 24% of our Director’s and Managing Directors are women.

About Citi Investor Services As part of Citi’s Services business, Investor Services is a global business that provides Custody, Fund Services, Issuer Services and Securities Finance to global asset managers, pension funds, insurance companies, banks and financial intermediaries. Investor Services operates the largest custody network globally with a presence in 60+ countries.

Position Summary

Do you excel at seeing and driving to the future state the Fund Services Industry despite knowing in detail the complexity of the current state in the highly data driven and complex area of Middle Office outsourcing? Are you a commercial, tech and operational change savvy business leader who doesn’t settle for good enough and pushes all to be the best? The role is to lead our Fund Services Middle Office function globally. This is global a P&l ownership role and therefore requires a deep hands-on working knowledge of the Funds business and in particular proven delivery of complex lift outs and builds for a global middle office service for asset managers. . The candidate would be required to lead, change, improve and grow materially the middle office function using technology as the enabler working hand in hand with operations, technology, our client teams and indeed our clients across a very broad US, Lux, Irish, Australian plus many smaller markets where we provide Middle Office services across existing and target clients.

The Product Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. Timely execution, seamless business and client change are extremely important to ensure Fund Services continues its growth path and expands its relationships with strategic clients.

Reporting to the Global Head of Fund Services, the Global Head of Middle Office services will lead strategic transformational change at the core of our business driving growth though innovation, digitisation, operating and financial performance. As part of the leadership team, this role will leverage broad Middle Office domain knowledge, deep experience influencing product, operations, design, and IT architecture change, as they lead the global function ensuring a 24/6 model delivering a single client experience across the globe.

Responsibilities

Commercially and strategically minded with responsibility to develop and execute the Middle Office strategy that aligns to the wider InvestorServices Strategy.
Ownership of the Global P&L for the function driving QoQ improvements via Monthly Business Review (MBR) deliverables
Own the IBOR product globally and partner with the accounting (ABOR) and Transfer Agency teams
Own pricing decisions for current and new Middle Office business and represent the funds business at local / regional and global deal review meetings
Expertise in all asset classes as they relate to a Middle Office service.
Be the difference between the think and the execution.
Work closely with Product owners to develop and drive product roadmaps that are inclusive of business operations and technology future change needs that have a keen eye on client experience, financial performance, control, and scalability.
Change the operating model of existing clients to drive efficiency, scale, lower risk and performance.
Collaborate with Business, Technology, Operations, Client Services, Finance and Risk to deliver upon future state front to back business architectures for ultimately single IBOR / ABOR capabilities enabling optimized solutions with low process friction between groups and functions.
Develop and communicate the product strategy & governance principles aimed at optimizing straight through processing and guaranteeing the timeliness, completeness, accuracy, and internal consistency of the accounting product and the resultant financial reporting, business processing, and overall client experience success.
Manage a broad range of data and SaaS vendors that provide services / data to the business. Ensure the bank wide standards are met for all vendors including strict commercial discipline. These will include global providers like Charles River, Blackrock Aladdin, Bloomberg AIM, Simcorp etc.
Design, build and deploy an enterprise data model that supports the end to end Middle Office business and aligns to the broader business data strategy.
Champion continuous improvement through a Product Innovation & Governance committee - driving adoption of industry best practices, and training to ensure that the Services business is a leader in the industry for modern and digital processes.
Leverage a strong understanding of the business strategy, key stakeholders and business capability and create solution roadmaps for clients and our teams
Solicit business and technical specific requirements with the understanding of how those fit into the broader enterprise context bringing them to the transformation / technology teams for enablement and delivery.
Socialize future state vision with all other Citi partners.
Own the Middle Office portfolio of work including with our technology vendors.
Spearhead and lead Agile initiatives and dynamically create agile squads. Head of Middle Office Services – Fund Services
Face off with both Fund Services and the broader Investor Services Transformation team to ensure connectivity, driving and owning the budgets for change.
Champion of communication across the global function ensuring no duplication or overlap looking for synergies with every decision.
Key partner for our client team and a trusted leader to deliver for the clients
Help drive Data team culture.
Work with Risk & Control team to implement data access controls.
Work with Legal, Risk, & Compliance partners on program policies
Lead efforts to establish, formalize and communicate business solutions and educate business stakeholders particularly the client teams on value and importance of proposed accounting solutions.
Work closely with all technical partners to align strategic technical investments to the target state business architecture or justify any deviations.
Drive client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, multiple countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within a region or business
Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
Drive a positive Voice of the Employee (VOE) rating each year – lead by example

Qualifications

10-15+ years Middle Office industry experience ideally in a fund services business or as a COO of a recognised asset manager. Ideally have a proven track record in re-engineering efforts across multiple Middle Office platforms (CRD, Aladdin , BBG AIM, SCD)
Exceptional communication & presentation skills
Have previous experience working with C-Suite stakeholders.
Has superior strategic, analytic and problem-solving skills, and is capable of clearly communicating a long term vision across the company and clients
Natural collaborator. Partner with product management teams and product delivery executives to ensure both product and client roadmaps and implementation strategies are aligned to technology and business investments.
Extensive experience in business process technology architecture engineering /implementations
Deep industry experience in tech solutions for Middle Office Services (Traditional and Alts)
Outcome oriented, with a successful track record of delivering excellence for our clients
Self-motivated, independent, multi-tasker, willing and able to take ownership of various parts of an initiative.
Ability to effectively deliver under time pressure, clarifying ambiguity as needed to deliver against expectations.
Ability to coordinate and tie break in complex and siloed organizations through Influence and develop strong relationships by driving value added change.
Must be disciplined and comfortable with ambiguity, possessing the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and a global matrixed organization
Ability to elevate the conversation to client’s needs and objectives, and also dig into the details and process flows
Flexible – demonstrated experience working effectively with multiple stake holders Head of Middle Office Services – Fund Services
Strong analytical skills, including numbers and situational analyses, and high attention to detail
Organization and project management skills, including effective cross-functional management skills
Team player
Able to prioritize work, and shift priorities as needed to meet aggressive deadlines and milestones
Promotes teamwork and builds strong relationships within and across global teams
